snippet.title: SPINE | Release Window Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
This is Gun Fu. Wishlist SPINE at https://spine.game/
Coming to PC, PS5, and Xbox Series in the Summer of 2027.

The wait is almost over! We're thrilled to reveal the release window for SPINE, our cinematic Gun Fu action game, in a brand-new trailer.

As development enters its final stretch, Nekki is ready to pull back the curtain on new story beats, fresh gameplay footage, and characters you haven't met yet, all packed into the latest look at SPINE.

Mark your calendars — SPINE is set to become one of the most anticipated releases of 2027.

SPINE’s new trailer offers a first look at Judge – Tensor City’s supreme leader – along with Tensor’s Children, Edda Kopp and Malady, equipped with Spines of their own. The new trailer also showcases SPINE’s directional attacks, parry and dodge system, environmental attacks and a number of the game’s bosses, as well as a variety of new environments, from tangled underground laboratories to the vast cliffs of the City’s Greenhouse, and a fight atop a high-speed train.
